caption: The drawing features a central, full-color figure of a woman dressed in 19th-century clothing, including a large black bonnet, a beige or light brown fringed shawl draped over her shoulders, a white blouse, dark gloves, and a long, full black skirt. To the left of the main figure, there is a smaller, lighter sketch of a woman's portrait shown from the chest up, also wearing a bonnet and a shawl. Below this portrait, there is a detailed drawing of a folded shawl. To the right of the central figure, there are two line drawings of long-sleeved, high-waisted dresses, rendered without color and showing construction details. The overall composition combines colored figures with faint pencil outlines, and the background is a plain off-white. The artist's name, "L. Lilian Causey," appears in small text at the bottom left.
title: Shaker Dress
